label: Nonblocking: sample now, update later
subgoals: Read every right-hand side using the values from before the edge
Apply all updates together at the end of the edge
Repeat the edge to get values after several cycles

label: Blocking: update immediately
subgoals: Update each variable before executing the next statement
Track how statement order changes the result
Rename each blocking write as a new version of the variable

label: Mixing the two in one block
section: Mixing the two in one block
subgoals: Execute statements in order while queueing nonblocking updates
Read newly blocked values in later statements of the same edge
Restrict blocking writes to temporaries written before they are read
